# Together Counts

> Together Counts provides comprehensive health, nutrition, and STEM education resources for schools, families, and communities, with programs spanning pre-K through grade 5.

Together Counts is a nonprofit organization dedicated to preventing childhood obesity and promoting healthy lifestyles through evidence-based curriculum, community partnerships, and family engagement. The platform offers bilingual resources (English and Spanish) aligned with educational standards and serves diverse audiences including schools, homeschools, afterschool programs, Girl Scouts, and 4-H organizations.

## Key Topics

- Health and Wellness Education
- Nutrition Education
- Physical Activity Programs
- STEM Farming Education
- Childhood Obesity Prevention
- Family Resources
- Lesson Plans
- Community Programs
- Girl Scouts Resources
- 4-H Partnerships
- Afterschool Programming
- Food Literacy
- Active Lifestyle
- Youth Development

## Core Programs & Initiatives

- [Home - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com): Together Counts homepage introducing Farming Spotlight and educational resources
- [About - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/about): Organization mission and partnerships with health and education initiatives
- [At School - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/at-school): School curriculum and seasonal resources for health and wellness
- [At Home - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/at-home): Family resources including cookbooks and wellness activities
- [Healthy Communities - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/healthy-communities): Community health initiatives addressing obesity and food access
- [Principal - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/es): Spanish-language homepage for Juntos Contamos community programs

## School & Classroom Curriculum

- [Grades K-5 - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/grades-k-5): Elementary curriculum with lesson plans and classroom activities
- [Pre-K Overview - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/pre-k): Early childhood curriculum for nutrition and physical activity
- [School Toolkit - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/school-toolkit): Communication and marketing resources for school health programs
- [Educator Support Center - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/educator-support-center): Resources for educators implementing health and wellness curriculum
- [Home School Headquarters - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/home-school-headquarters): Homeschool curriculum for pre-K through grade 5 health education

## Specialized Programs & Learning Zones

- [Farming Spotlight - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/farming-spotlight): STEM farming lessons covering soil science and agricultural education
- [Enrichment Zone - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/enrichment-zone): Afterschool programming aligned with NAA HEPA standards
- [Scouts - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/scouts): Girl Scouts resources and healthy habits journeys

## Nutrition & Food Education

- [Did You Know? - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/did-you-know): Nutrition education content on healthy foods and portion control
- [FDA Fun-damentals - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/fda-fun-damentals): FDA nutrition facts and food label education for students

## Community & Partner Resources

- [Partner Toolkit - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/partner-toolkit): Marketing materials and outreach templates for community partners
- [Partner Resources - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/partner-resources): Resource directory for community program partners and 4-H

## Success Stories & Recognition

- [Meet our Winners - Together Counts](https://togethercounts.com/meet-our-winners): Award recipients and success stories from Smart from the Start program
